description: Every formula of the old language has the same truth value in an expansion and its reduct under the same free assignment and scoped tuple.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.LHom.realize_onBoundedFormula.{u, v, w, u', u_4, u_5} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {L' : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} [L'.Structure M] (φ : L →ᴸ L')
  [φ.IsExpansionOn M] {n : ℕ} (ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n) {v : α → M} {xs : Fin n → M} :
  (φ.onBoundedFormula ψ).Realize v xs ↔ ψ.Realize v xs
